rules.instruction: When the description states that, while other activities are under way, a participant performs a further preparation step of its own (for example, readying an item in parallel with the work of others): Model that described step as its own task on a parallel branch that starts at the same split as the concurrent activities, and join it with those branches before the step that depends on all of them. Do not drop the step or fold it into another task.
rules.situation: the description states that, while other activities are under way, a participant performs a further preparation step of its own (for example, readying an item in parallel with the work of others)

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs an action that is a step of the process, such as communicating an outcome to another party or collecting feedback from a party, and that action happens on only one branch of a decision or after the main work is done: Model each such performed action as a task, placed on every branch where the description states it occurs and in the order the description gives. Do not replace the performed action with an intermediate throw or catch event. Reserve intermediate events for occurrences the process waits for or reacts to.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant may postpone a later step of its own, as an optional and conditional delay that applies when the participant has other pending work

rules.instruction: When the description states that an actor may defer a later step, such as a settlement or recording step, when it has other pending work of its own, so the deferral is optional and depends on whether that other work exists: Model the deferral as its own task placed on the path before the point where the actor checks whether other pending work exists. Follow it with an exclusive gateway on that condition. One outgoing flow performs the other pending work and returns to the check; the other flow continues to the deferred step. Do not drop the deferral task, do not merge it with the other pending work, and do not connect the deferred step directly to the check gateway.
rules.situation: the description states that an actor may defer a later step, such as a settlement or recording step, when it has other pending work of its own, so the deferral is optional and depends on whether that other work exists

rules.instruction: When the description lists several activities performed by one actor in a comma-separated sequence, states no ordering or dependency among them, and then a later activity is described as following all of them: Model the listed activities as parallel branches: fork them from the preceding step with a parallel gateway, and join them with a parallel gateway before the later activity, so the later activity waits for all branches. Do not chain the unordered activities in a fixed sequence unless the description states an order.
rules.situation: The description says that an activity by one actor is carried out while other activities by other actors are ongoing, and a later step is described as needing all of these activities to be finished, with no order stated between them.
